title: Assert API pagination metadata
description: Checks only the number of returned items on a paginated endpoint.
issue_description: The endpoint could return the right number of items while exposing broken page or cursor metadata.
issue_suggestion: Assert the pagination fields that clients rely on, not only the item list length.

title: Avoid asserting implementation-specific SQL counts
description: Checks how many ORM calls happened during a service method.
issue_title: Test is coupled to internal query count details
issue_description: Refactors that preserve behavior can still break this test if they change the internal call pattern.
issue_suggestion: Assert the externally visible result unless the number of queries is the actual contract.

title: Seed minimal fixture data
description: Loads a large fixture file when the test needs one user.
issue_description: Large fixture payloads slow the suite down and make the scenario harder to understand.
issue_suggestion: Create only the records needed for the test case.

title: Check HTTP status before parsing JSON
description: Parses a response body immediately in an integration test.
issue_title: Test hides failures behind JSON parsing
issue_description: If the route returns an error page, the test fails in a less informative place than the status assertion.
issue_suggestion: Assert the HTTP status first, then inspect the parsed body.

title: Avoid duplicate coverage with copy-pasted tests
description: Repeats the same authorization test for several roles with manual duplication.
issue_title: The suite duplicates the same pattern manually
issue_description: Copy-pasted cases are harder to extend consistently and tend to drift over time.
issue_suggestion: Use a table-driven or parameterized test to cover the roles together.

title: Assert emitted metrics when they matter
description: Exercises a cache miss path without checking observability output.
issue_title: Important observability side effect is untested
issue_description: If dashboards or alerts depend on metrics, missing metric emission is a real regression.
issue_suggestion: Assert the metric increment for the scenario that was exercised.

title: Keep snapshot tests scoped and readable
description: Snapshots an entire API response with unstable fields.
issue_description: Large snapshots with timestamps and ids become hard to review and fail too often for low-signal reasons.
issue_suggestion: Snapshot only the stable fields that represent the contract you care about.

title: Make authorization intent explicit in fixtures
description: Uses a default user fixture in an admin-only route test.
issue_title: Fixture does not guarantee the required role
issue_description: If the default fixture stops being an admin, the test meaning changes unexpectedly.
issue_suggestion: Construct a fixture with the explicit role required by the scenario.

title: Do not reuse production credentials in tests
description: Builds an integration test with a real API key from the environment.
issue_description: Using live secrets makes the suite fragile, unsafe, and environment-dependent.
issue_suggestion: Use test doubles or sandbox credentials isolated from production.

title: Verify empty-state behavior explicitly
description: Tests only the populated dashboard state.
issue_description: Pages often break or degrade awkwardly when no data exists, and this scenario is not covered.
issue_suggestion: Add a dedicated test for the no-data state and its message.
